name: MoleculeNet Drug Discovery Benchmark
description: A widely used benchmark suite for drug discovery machine learning, covering molecular property prediction, classification, and related tasks across multiple datasets.
evaluation_method: dataset-dependent metrics such as ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, RMSE, MAE, and accuracy depending on the task and target property
notes: MoleculeNet is a benchmark suite rather than a single task. Scores are usually reported per dataset and per metric, so a single scalar SOTA score is not meaningful.
